newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stronger Chicago sparks late European feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: Stronger Chicago sparks late European feeds trade.

text.p: A stronger Chicago soymeal futures opening and a weaker dollar sparked late activity on the european meals and feeds market, but most of the business was done for nearby material, market sources said.

"After yesterday's stronger Chicago close buyers waited for a confirmation of the up-trend and then bought some nearby material. But there was little proof buyers expected the market to stay strong for a longer period because there was not much interest for more distant positions," one broker said.
After around 90 minutes of trade CBOT soymeal futures were between $2.4 and $4.1 up from yesterday's close.
